title: A Complete and Natural Rule Set for Multi-Qudit Clifford Circuits in All Odd Prime Dimensions
summary: We present a complete set of $16$ rewrite rules for multi-qudit Clifford circuits in all odd prime dimensions. Completeness means that any two Clifford circuits representing the same linear map can be rewritten into each other using these rules. Each rule involves at most three qudits and admits an intuitive interpretation. To establish completeness, we first work at the symplectic level, using the isomorphism between the symplectic group $\mathrm{Sp}(2n,\mathbb{Z}_p)$ and the quotient of the Clifford group by the Pauli group.
